confirmations.text: The purchase entries recorded in the notebook match the supplier receipt totals.
The owner's interview statement about weekly material spending aligns with the supplier receipts.

memo.headline: The application is partially verified and meets policy criteria, with the requested monthly repayment fitting within capacity limits despite an absence of digital banking evidence.

character.text: The business has operated for 12 years in Yogyakarta, showing established stability. The owner's statements regarding sales of 200 to 300 thousand IDR per day and material costs around 700 thousand IDR per week correspond closely with the notebook records and supplier receipts. However, all revenue transactions remain entirely cash-based without digital confirmation.

capacity.text: Based purely on hard verification, monthly revenue is Rp 0, as digital payment history is not used. Taking into account ledger entries, revenue reaches Rp 7.355.000, leaving a net monthly cash flow of Rp 3.827.500 after monthly costs of Rp 3.527.500. Under policy haircut rules, the capacity basis of Rp 2.296.500 supports a maximum instalment of Rp 688.950, which covers the requested instalment of Rp 688.531.

capital.text: The file lacks shop photographs to directly evaluate inventory levels and equipment value on site. However, purchase receipts from Toko Kain Sinar Jaya confirm regular weekly material acquisition totaling Rp 3.027.500 per month, matching ledger entries for cloth, zippers, and buttons. Operating commitments also show steady shop rental payments of 500 thousand IDR recorded each month.

collateral.text: Physical collateral documentation and asset photos are not present in the current submission. Since the requested loan of Rp 8.000.000 is well within the KUR collateral-free threshold of Rp 100.000.000, secondary physical collateral may not be mandated. Credit evaluation will instead rely directly on demonstrated operational cash flow.

conditions.text: The borrower seeks a Rp 8.000.000 facility over 12 months to purchase a second sewing machine to accelerate uniform completion. The enterprise serves a recurring local client base in Yogyakarta, including uniform and kebaya orders as well as tailoring repairs. No broader sector data or formal contracts were provided.

officer_next_steps: Conduct an on-site inspection to capture shop photos, verify existing sewing machines, and document fabric inventory.
Inspect recent supplier invoices or request bank statements to confirm daily cash deposits.
Confirm the machine supplier's price quote for the planned equipment purchase.

owner_summary.verified: Catatan pembukuan harian dan nota pembelian kain dari Toko Kain Sinar Jaya telah sesuai dengan penjelasan usaha jahit Anda selama 12 tahun.
owner_summary.missing: Bukti foto kios atau mesin jahit saat ini belum tersedia, dan seluruh penerimaan transaksi usaha masih berjalan secara tunai tanpa riwayat QRIS atau mutasi bank.
tips: Minta nota tertulis lengkap dan bertanggal dari toko perlengkapan jahit setiap kali berbelanja bahan.
Sediakan QRIS atau transfer bank untuk pelanggan agar transaksi pemasukan tercatat otomatis oleh perbankan.
Simpan foto tempat kerja dan mesin jahit yang sedang beroperasi untuk melengkapi berkas usaha.
owner_summary.verified_en: Your daily bookkeeping records and fabric purchase receipts from Toko Kain Sinar Jaya match your 12 years of tailoring business experience.
owner_summary.missing_en: Photos of your current kiosk or sewing machines are not yet available, and all business transactions are still conducted in cash without any QRIS history or bank statements.
tips_en: Ask for a complete, dated written receipt from the sewing supply store every time you purchase materials.
Provide QRIS or bank transfer options for customers so that income transactions are automatically recorded by the bank.
Keep photos of your workspace and operating sewing machines to complete your business files.
